verdict.rationale: xAI documents first-party retention controls: a default 30-day retention and a self-serve Zero Data Retention toggle per team in Team Settings, under which prompts and outputs are never persisted to disk. A per-response `x-zero-data-retention` header confirms the setting programmatically. The deletion half of the story has no evidence: nothing documents deleting stored data, files or collections, or setting custom retention periods. Missing for 10: documented deletion controls for already-retained data or files, configurable retention windows beyond default vs. ZDR, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
